objective: Evidence-complete, label-concealed and score-blind sensitivity review of all 80 current Chinese valid/test positive candidates mixed with 80 frozen negative controls. Reviewers receive raw Step4 pair evidence, raw per-side Step3 contact occurrences, and independently reconstructed contact-component candidate paths, but no prior label, tier, parser eligibility flag, model score, graph membership, or review conclusion.

component_candidate_path.source: Step3 direct_identity_eligible token graph, exposed only as raw token/path candidates
component_candidate_path.scientific_role: candidate evidence only; every occurrence context must be independently checked

strict_positive_requirement: Shared seller-facing direct identifier visible in raw occurrences, or an independently closed component path whose every seller-facing token occurrence is visible and credible. Template, topic, product/victim data, public URL, and marketplace-support overlap are insufficient.
soft_positive_requirement: Strong structural/style/clone support without sufficient direct identity proof; sensitivity analysis only and never strict gold.
hard_rules: Reviewers must not inspect Step7, Step9, Step15, Step17, or Step11 scores or predictions.
Reviewers must not see pair_uid, previous review_label, evidence_type, paper_evidence_tier, parser seller_facing/direct_identity eligibility flags, or old review notes.
Raw occurrence source_field/raw_value/context/title/description snippets may be shown because they are evidence, not prior conclusions.
The concealed blind-id mapping must not be provided to reviewers or the adjudicator.
Every disagreement requires a separate adjudication decision with written evidence rationale.
The aggregation script never modifies Step5 or Step16F and v3 cannot be used to retune Step15-v6.
